title: ObsmetrologiaAxiomLawGate record
description: The gate record assembled by assembleGateRecord (src/axiom-law-gate.mjs:175-187) and written to `<outDir>/<date>-axiom-law-gate.json` by main() (scripts/gate-axiom-law.mjs:161-172). The script also prints a related but narrower object to stdout — `{summary, baseline, baselineUpdate, gate}` (scripts/gate-axiom-law.mjs:174), which omits type/checkedAt/packageRoot/leanSourcePath/reading/allowedAxioms and adds baselineUpdate — and exits with `gate.exitCode` (scripts/gate-axiom-law.mjs:175). This schema describes the on-disk record, the fuller and canonical shape.

checkedAt.description: `new Date().toISOString()` at the time main() ran the census (scripts/gate-axiom-law.mjs:162-163; carried into the record at src/axiom-law-gate.mjs:178).

packageRoot.description: Absolute filesystem path to the Obsmetrologia Lean package the census ran against; DEFAULT_PACKAGE_ROOT unless the entrypoint is invoked programmatically with an override (scripts/gate-axiom-law.mjs:22,140; src/axiom-law-gate.mjs:179).

leanSourcePath.description: Absolute filesystem path to the Lean meta program the gate drives via `lake env lean` — census-set-of-theorem-axioms.lean; DEFAULT_LEAN_SOURCE_PATH unless overridden programmatically (scripts/gate-axiom-law.mjs:25,141; src/axiom-law-gate.mjs:180).

reading.description: AXIOM_LAW_READING: fixed prose stating the axiom-law discipline the gate enforces, for a reader of the record with no other context (src/axiom-law-gate.mjs:144-150, embedded at line 181).

allowedAxioms.description: The law's single source of truth, re-exported from proof-work-order.mjs's ALLOWED_AXIOMS (src/proof-work-order.mjs:27; re-exported at src/axiom-law-gate.mjs:15,19; embedded at line 182). Currently exactly ["Quot.sound"] (owner ruling 2026-09-21).

baseline.description: The ratchet baseline violation count in force for this run: the value just written when decideBaselineUpdate decided to write (init/ratchet), otherwise the existing recorded value, or null when none is on record yet (src/axiom-law-gate.mjs:129,183; scripts/gate-axiom-law.mjs:124-129).

pass.description: `!overBaseline`: frontier theorems are counted, not failed (src/axiom-law-gate.mjs, decideGate).

overBaseline.description: True when a numeric baseline is on record and current violations exceed it (src/axiom-law-gate.mjs:113).

exitCode.description: 0 when pass, else 1; also the script's own process.exit code (src/axiom-law-gate.mjs:115; scripts/gate-axiom-law.mjs:175).

summary.description: summarizeAxiomLaw's aggregation of the census rows against the axiom law (src/axiom-law-gate.mjs:64-99, embedded at line 185).

violations.description: Count of rows carrying any axiom outside ALLOWED_AXIOMS other than the frontier mark `sorryAx`, i.e. `isViolation(row.axioms)` true (src/axiom-law-gate.mjs, isViolation).

frontier.description: Count of rows carrying `sorryAx`: frontier theorems, stated with a proof still to come; reported, never failed (src/axiom-law-gate.mjs, isFrontier).

frontierTheorems.description: Fully-qualified names of the frontier rows, in census (sorted) order (src/axiom-law-gate.mjs, summarizeAxiomLaw).

violatingTheorems.description: Fully-qualified names of every violating row, in census (sorted) order (src/axiom-law-gate.mjs:67,80,95).

profiles.description: Histogram of profileOf(row.axioms) (theorem-census.mjs:44-54, imported at src/axiom-law-gate.mjs:14) over all rows; keys are drawn from "sorry", "choice", "propext+Quot.sound", "Quot.sound", "propext", "none" (src/axiom-law-gate.mjs:65,72,96).

theorems.description: Rows censused for this module, keyed by moduleOf(row.name) (src/axiom-law-gate.mjs:74-76).

byModule.description: Per-module {theorems, violations} counts, keyed by the Obsmetrologia module segment (src/axiom-law-gate.mjs:66,74-81,97).

topViolatingModules.description: Modules with violations > 0, as [moduleName, violationCount] pairs, sorted by violation count descending then module name ascending, capped at 30 (src/axiom-law-gate.mjs:85-89,98).
